caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a desk or writing table, shown in a reddish-brown color. The desk has a slanted top that is partially open, revealing compartmentalized storage spaces within, divided by vertical separators. The front of the desk features rectangular paneled sections, and the desk rests on four turned legs. The main colored depiction of the desk is placed towards the center left of the composition. On the right side of the drawing, there is a lightly sketched, uncolored side view outline of the desk, including similar detailing of the sloped lid and turned legs. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects present.
title: Sugar Chest
